bootstrap.method: moving-block bootstrap: ceil(n/b) blocks of length b with uniform start positions 0..n-b drawn by numpy PCG64 default_rng(seed), concatenated and truncated to n; each resample re-estimates the empirical threshold under the FIXED quantile policy and refits the GPD independently
bootstrap.threshold_policy: fixed quantile policy q=0.95; u re-estimated per resample
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional on the threshold policy and the block-dependence assumption; does not capture threshold-selection uncertainty or regime change.
